title: Robolympic Batons
source_topic: CodeChef / ACM-ICPC India Regionals, Online Preliminary Round 2016
statement: Today is the Robolympics athletic event. N batons numbered 0 to N - 1 are placed in a circular fashion where baton numbers increase in clockwise direction. Also, some of the batons are special . M robots start in the event by standing near a baton position and picking it up.
